g.text: Compare average monthly electricity production in GWh across the four weather profiles.
Plot 1 (wind): monthly mean wind speed vs wind power, colored by season
Plot 2 (temp): monthly mean temperature vs total production, colored by season
Converts month_date to a Date for the time axis of the line plot
Adds day 01 to month so it can be read as a date
Plot 3: monthly electricity production by type over time
Plot 4 (heatmap): Pearson correlation between weather and energy variables
